# Deprecated: old stone markers

These photos show end B's counters with the old, partly worn dots. On 2026-11-22 the dots were
renewed, and end B couldn't be photographed again then. The photos stay for the counter reader's
ratchet (`ReferencePhotosTest`), but new readers are judged without them
(`ReferencePhoto.deprecated`). Replace them with photos of the renewed dots, then delete this file.
